items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: The Bennett Sisters... used to come out there. So we practically knew all of the motion picture stars of that day because we knew that as coming-up starlets...

ctx.x: Oh, it was -- all the movie people of Hollywood came to Sebastian's Cotton Club at one time or the other. The first week that Georgie Raft (PHONETIC) came in town, the first place he came out to was Sebastian's Cotton Club. Texas Guinan (PHONETIC) had sent for him. He was sup-

posed to have been the take-off of the day on Rudolph Valentino, but he was too short. That's what he was brought out for. He was a ballroom dancer and they brought him out. He used to come out there all the time. All the movie stars, the Bennett Sisters, all the Talmadge Sisters, Norma and Constance, they used to come out there. Just about everybody that you could think of that was in big time show business came to Sebastian's Cotton Club because it was the biggest nightclub in the world, sizewise and it had…

So we practically knew all of the motion picture stars of that day because we knew that as coming-up starlets and coming-up stars from the start to the beginning. We knew when they got a hit and when they didn't, you know? Joan Crawford used to be out, Rosalind Russell. ~~The guy ~~ Clark Gable -- all of the guys that really stood for something in the business.
